label: Claude Code
models_comment: The Claude CLI has no models endpoint, so this list is shipped, not detected. Edit data/agents.json to pin or add ids.

label: Codex CLI
models_comment: kind=suggest: these ids were valid on codex-cli 0.144.0-alpha.4 but the CLI exposes no models endpoint, so they are shown as suggestions and never asserted present. An unsupported id returns HTTP 400 from codex.

label: aider
bin_probe_comment: Hints only — PATH (shutil.which) is tried first. '*' matches one path component, so ~/Library/Python/*/bin/aider finds any pip --user install without pinning a Python minor version.
models_comment: kind=detect: aider's model list is whatever the local Ollama actually has pulled, so it is probed at runtime (GET {base}/api/tags) rather than shipped. fallback=[] because no tag exists on a fresh machine.
env_comment: Loopback default. To use a remote or non-default Ollama, edit OLLAMA_API_BASE in data/agents.json (machine state) — not here in defaults/.

label: prime-agent (remote)
label_comment: Generic on purpose: the shipped seed must not name anyone's machine. Rename it in data/agents.json (machine state) to whatever that box is actually called.
bin_probe_comment: No hints needed: the server puts its own bin/ on PATH at import, so the shipped wrapper resolves by bare name wherever ZENITH is installed.
argv_comment: The whole agent runs on another machine, inside a container. bin/pa-job.sh takes the prompt as ONE ordinary argv element and base64-encodes it before it reaches a remote shell, so no prompt can become syntax over there. {model} is deliberately absent: the container's own config selects the model.
models_comment: kind=suggest: the model is whatever the remote container is configured with, and ZENITH cannot probe inside it — so this labels the arm and asserts nothing. Changing it does not change the run.
mode_flags_comment: The container IS the sandbox (non-root, cap-drop ALL, egress-locked, no home mount), so ZENITH's permission modes have no filesystem to gate. They select EFFORT instead: default = one shot, prompt in / answer out; the other two add --autonomous, which keeps working past the first reply until the run's own limits stop it.
transcript_comment: The run is stateless by design (--no-session): the JSONL event stream on stdout IS the record, and it lands in the job's console and job.end payload. Nothing to glob for.
requires: A reachable prime-agent host. Configure it in data/pa.json ({host, job, worktree_root}) or ZENITH_PA_HOST — never in source, which ships publicly.
notes: Remote-only agent: nothing runs on this machine but an ssh. Enable in data/agents.json once data/pa.json points at a box.
